description: Measure captured component renders during supplied interaction steps or an idle window. Returns available timings, render counts, reported reasons and changed props. The wasted count is a diagnostic classification, not proof a render can be removed. Check interaction warnings before comparing runs. Use the same steps and comparable conditions with compareToPrevious:true after editing; the comparison alone does not prove correctness or overall performance. Requires Buoy Pro and a highlight-updates integration exposing beginMeasurement. Use run_benchmark_batch to compare route-based variants.

compareToPrevious.description: Compare with the previous measurement on this device. Use equivalent steps and conditions; review warnings and behavior separately.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

idleMs.description: Idle sample length when no steps are given. Default 3000.

label.description: Name this measurement, e.g. "before fix". Shown in the next comparison.

steps.description: The interaction to measure, e.g. [{tap:'favorite-deal-2', repeat:5}] or [{type:'bench', into:'deals-search'}]. Omit to sample the screen idle — only useful for churn that happens with nobody touching it.

items.description: One interaction to measure. Keep it to the thing you're asking about.

into.description: Target text input for `type`: testID or fuzzy text.

repeat.description: Do this step N times (default 1). Useful for 'tap it five times'.

tap.description: Tap this element: exact testID, or fuzzy visible text.

waitMs.description: Pause after the action, in ms.

name: measure_renders
